description_en: Retrieves statistics for the details of an AI application
description_zh: 获取AI应用详情的统计数据
name: GetAiAppDetailStat

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AI application. This parameter is required
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the application resides
parameters.name: region_id
